description: The plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop frequency, comparing initial and final accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. There are two lines in the plot, both featuring vertical error bars at each data point. The "Initial Accuracy" line is a solid green line with dot markers. It starts at approximately 0.4 at x=1, fluctuates with peaks near 0.75 at x=7 and 0.65 at x=11, and dips near 0.45 at x=9 and x=15, before rising to end at approximately 0.95 at x=19. The "Final Accuracy" line is a dashed blue line with dot markers. It begins at approximately 0.6 at x=1, rises sharply to about 0.9 at x=3, and remains relatively stable and high between 0.9 and 1.0 for the remainder of the plot, ending at approximately 1.0 at x=19.
